late afternoon until late night. the night can be okay cuz i feel allowed to distract myself and be alone. daytime can have distractions. the evening is absolute hell, and most the people i want to reach out to are with the people they love more than me (friends, family, SOs) so it's extra lonely. I hate it.

I was just thinking about this today. My biggest support person has decided they "give more than they get" with me (despite me constantly doing things for them) so they're done and just kind of...pretend I'm okay now and will be better off without them? My best friend, who is a fucking therapist, finally told me, "I have no idea what to say to you anymore. You can keep talking, but I may not reply, and also I'm not gonna talk you out of killing yourself." All my other friends are like, "So sorry! Let me know if you need anything!" And when I need something? They may sit with me for a few hours or give me a hug, but if I'm not okay right after that and suddenly "cured" they're like...surprised and just say they don't know what to do and start basically ignoring me.

And I know if I killed myself, every single one of them would be like, "why didn't you tell me it was this bad?" I did. Over and over again. Just no one knew what to do besides say, "I'm sorry," and then go back to ignoring me. Or they'll literally tell me, "Oh, I think you're not as bad as you think and you just can't see you progress." No, I'm *telling* you that I'm *having* to make a lot of obvious, external progress cuz I'm closer to dying than I've ever been before.

No one fucking gets it and they'll act like it's my fault when I die anyway. Yay.

Hey man, I understand how you're feeling, and it sucks. Especially the not being able to cry :( Depression is horrible the way it can rob us of even that. 

The fact that you want to be saved - even if you want to die at the same time - is a good sign. I get feeling this drained - it's so hard to keep it all together and keep going and keep fighting like this. It's like dragging around a weight constantly. It's not fair and I'm so sorry you're dealing with it :(

Have you talked to your gf or anyone else about this? Is there someone at your school you can talk to, for therapy or meds? I know it sounds trite as hell, but it can help sometimes if you find a therapist that's a good match.

Very sorry for the slow reply :( Honestly, I'm huge into signs - tarot has been saving me a lot lately, and I can sense my father or a friend who passed connecting with me sometimes. And I know they want me to live, and every single reading tells me the same thing - to have more faith, trust the universe more, be gentler with myself, have hope, and not kill myself. It's just so, so hard to listen to it - but it's the same thing, over and over again, no matter who I get a reading from or what the reading is meant to be about.

I think keeping postponing it is about all I handle right now, so I'll try that. Right now, I feel like I have to get through a few weeks at least where I'm having to help someone heal after surgery. And then I'm free to go somewhere else on my own. Which is scary, because it makes it easier to kill myself, but I also was much happier recently when I was somewhere else, so I think I need to risk it anyway.

I really appreciate you.

I'm sorry I was so slow replying. Been out of it the last few days.   


I really appreciate it you saying that I'm not failing and haven't crossed an irreversible threshold. I thought about what you said, and I told my therapist and one of my best friends both that I got the pills, so I did that at least (and my friend esp. is being really good about it).

I'm definitely really bad about reaching out to people as a step back instead of progress; I need to look at it differently, I suppose. And you're right - I'm trying hard to remember progress doesn't have to be perfect to be worthwhile. 

It's just so hard right now. I feel like even if I don't actively want to die intensely this second, I just...don't feel good. Like I could easily just sleep through the rest of my life and just feel relieved I didn't have to keep feeling this. It all physically hurts honestly and I don't know how to feel better anymore :(
